## Summary

SITE: `src/rebar/_commands/compact_trigger.py` `run_sweep(tracker)` — `repo_root = os.path.dirname(tracker)`, sanctioned `# repo-root-ok:` in the AC#3 guard (`scripts/check_repo_root_from_tracker.py`) as the ONE deferred CONFIG-ROOT site.

CONTEXT: split off from auspicial-friended-merganser (2ec7-be89-9b01-496a), which fixed the 8 clean `os.path.dirname(tracker)`-as-config-root sites. `run_sweep` is the DETACHED-CHILD compaction entry point: it is spawned with cwd == the canonical STORE and inherits only `tracker` as its handle. This site was deliberately DEFERRED by auspicial because the detached child needs a DURABLE code-root and the two supported topologies (relocated store vs. co-located worktree symlink) disagree on how to derive it.

IMPACT (milder than the parent's AC#1): on a relocated store (`REBAR_TRACKER_DIR` — the deployed MCP topology, store `/var/gerrit/site/mcp-tickets`, code checkout `/var/gerrit/site/mcp-code`) `run_sweep` reads DEFAULT compaction config (threshold 10, 1800 s horizon) instead of the project's `[compact]` block. Compaction still runs; it folds the right tickets by the WRONG rule. No gate is disabled.

## The answer — RESOLVE a DURABLE root (operator-approved; supersedes the deferral)

Give the detached compaction child a DURABILITY-RESOLVED code root via a dedicated leaf resolver, `compaction_child_repo_root(canonical_tracker)` in `_config_resolvers.py`, with precedence:

  explicit `REBAR_ROOT` (realpath) if set  →  else `dirname(canonical tracker)`.

`run_sweep` calls it as `compaction_child_repo_root(StorePaths(tracker).canonical)`. This is correct for BOTH supported topologies WITHOUT depending on the child's cwd:

- **Deployment** (relocated store): `REBAR_ROOT` is exported UNCONDITIONALLY (`infra/compose/Dockerfile.mcp:102` ENV; `infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh:294` documents that it sits deliberately outside the PAT guard) and names the PROVISIONED CHECKOUT at `/var/gerrit/site/mcp-code`. The first precedence arm resolves a real code root, so the sweep composes from that root's `rebar.toml` instead of the store parent's default rule.
- **Local `make worktree`** (store co-located via a `.tickets-tracker` SYMLINK, ephemeral worktree): with `REBAR_ROOT` unset the fallback arm returns `dirname(canonical tracker)`, and `StorePaths(tracker).canonical` realpath-resolves the worktree's `.tickets-tracker` symlink back to the DURABLE main checkout's store (`realpath` load-bearing precisely to escape the worktree symlink, bugs 3198/93a9). So the fallback lands on the durable code root without reading the child's cwd at all.

This is the site auspicial-friended-merganser (Gerrit 2326) deferred; same defect class as injurious-pugnacious-azurevase (Gerrit 2339). The fix removes the `# repo-root-ok:` sanction at the site (relates to ADR 0051 — foreground git maintenance is never detached; this detached child does config resolution only, no git maintenance). It does NOT overlap the realpath/abspath config-root family in flowered-basaltic-beagle (088b-e4c1-050c-4516): this fix routes through `StorePaths.canonical`, not a raw `realpath`/`abspath` wrapper, so it introduces no new per-site realpath decision of that family's kind.

### Rejected alternatives

- **Threading the caller's resolved `repo_root` from `maybe_compact` through the spawn contract**: the parent's root is the DYING worktree — a `make worktree` git-toplevel can be deleted out from under the running detached child, re-running the durability class of 3198/93a9.
- **`config.repo_root_or_none()`** (explicit > `REBAR_ROOT` > git-toplevel-of-**cwd**): its non-`REBAR_ROOT` fallback reads the child's CWD. That only lands on the durable checkout if the child's cwd happens to be anchored there, so it leans on `detached_child_cwd` behaviour and re-runs the same worktree-durability class if the cwd is a dying worktree toplevel. `dirname(canonical tracker)` is durable independent of cwd.
- **`snapshot_repo_root()`**: adds a snapshot-specific `"."` fallback `run_sweep` does not want (`_config_resolvers.py`); a code root that silently becomes the cwd is the fatherly-incoherent-mare outage shape.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC#1 — `run_sweep` resolves the code/config root independent of where the store lives, by calling the dedicated resolver `compaction_child_repo_root(StorePaths(tracker).canonical)` (precedence `REBAR_ROOT` realpath > `dirname(canonical tracker)`): no spawn-contract change, no caller-threaded root, no `repo_root_or_none()` git-toplevel-of-cwd arm, no `snapshot_repo_root()`. Proven by AC#2's seam assertion.
- [ ] AC#2 — On a relocated store (external `REBAR_TRACKER_DIR`, `REBAR_ROOT` set to the checkout) with a non-default `[compact]` block, `run_sweep` honours it (RED->GREEN), AND the root it hands `compact_all_cli` IS the resolved code root — pinned at the seam, so a fix that merely lands on a root reading the same config by accident is still caught. Config must come from a `rebar.toml` FILE, never `REBAR_COMPACT_THRESHOLD` / `REBAR_COMPACTION_HORIZON_NS`, because an env read is root-independent and would hide the bug. Proved by `tests/unit/test_relocated_store_repo_root.py::test_run_sweep_folds_by_the_repo_compact_config_on_relocated_store` and `::test_run_sweep_hands_the_resolved_code_root_to_the_sweep`.
- [ ] AC#3 — The `# repo-root-ok:` sanction is removed from `compact_trigger.py`, leaving the guard's allowlist with ZERO deferred config-root sites. The only sanctions remaining are `_store/sync.py`'s `tickets_branch`/`tickets_remote` reads (landed under injurious-pugnacious-azurevase), which name refs in the STORE's own git repo and are legitimately rooted there. Proved by `tests/unit/test_repo_root_from_tracker_guard.py::test_no_config_root_site_is_deferred_behind_a_sanction` and by `python scripts/check_repo_root_from_tracker.py` exiting 0.
- [ ] AC#4 — The FALLBACK arm is exercised, not just the deployed one: a test with `REBAR_ROOT` UNSET and a real `.tickets-tracker` SYMLINK store proves `dirname(canonical tracker)` resolves the symlink back to the durable checkout and reaches the code root (`::test_run_sweep_resolves_the_code_root_without_rebar_root`), so the local half of the argument above is not merely asserted. The seam is pinned to `dirname(canonical)`, NOT the ephemeral worktree dir.
- [ ] AC#5 — A config-effect contrast shows the fold is the repo config being read, not an unconditional sweep: the same store and ticket fold NOTHING under a `[compact]` block whose horizon puts the events out of reach. The HORIZON is the discriminator, not the threshold — `_scan_snapshot_state` (`src/rebar/_commands/compact.py`) asks `compact_plan.needs_folding`, whose BACKFILL arm selects any snapshot-less ticket with at least one foldable event whatever the threshold. Proved by `::test_run_sweep_respects_a_repo_config_that_folds_nothing`, which asserts LIVENESS (the sweep actually REACHED `compact_all_cli`) separately from the seam and the no-snapshot outcome — `run_sweep` swallows every exception, so an absent SNAPSHOT would otherwise be satisfied by a crash.
- [ ] AC#6 — Caused-by attribution: same origin class as the parent (`dirname(tracker)`-as-config-root construct); this site was written by `d2dea317ec94` (rebar-ticket `1fde-becd-942a-4351`), recorded as a `caused_by` link.

## Testing

Run every command from the change's worktree with its venv first on `PATH`.

- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python -m pytest tests/unit/test_relocated_store_repo_root.py tests/unit/test_repo_root_from_tracker_guard.py tests/unit/test_compact_trigger.py -q --color=no` — the relocated-store fold and the seam assertion are RED before the fix and GREEN after; the guard self-test reports no deferred config-root site; the existing trigger suite does not regress.
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python scripts/check_repo_root_from_tracker.py` — exits 0 on the drained tree (AC#3).
- Sandboxed mutation check (macOS `sandbox-exec`), each mutant applied then reverted to the fix: (1) re-seeding `repo_root = os.path.dirname(tracker)` returns ALL four run_sweep tests to RED (the bug itself); (2) replacing the resolver with a bare `repo_root = None` leaves the pure-fold test GREEN (`compose_config(None)` rediscovers `REBAR_ROOT`) and is caught ONLY by the three seam-bearing tests — the "a different path rescues the fold" case the seam assertion exists for; (3) `os.path.dirname(os.path.realpath(tracker))` (dropping the `REBAR_ROOT` precedence) is killed by the relocated-store tests and survives ONLY the symlink test, demonstrating why both precedence arms are needed.
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint && make typecheck` — no regressions.
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python -m pytest tests/unit/test_module_size_contract.py -q --color=no` and `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check` — the CI-only module-size gate and the complexity ratchet stay clean (`new=0 increased=0`).
